errors.text_span: “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal hatch) is about 81% for 7B, about 85% for 13B, and about 85% for 70B; and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (solid light pink) is about 84% for 7B, about 80% for 13B, and about 84% for 70B.
errors.evidence: The figure shows the purple bars at approximately 80%, 85%, and 84% for 7B/13B/70B, and the pink bars at approximately 83%, 80%, and 83% respectively. The description swaps/overstates several of these values.

The reference notes the distinct visual styling of the bars: blue with white diagonal stripes, yellow with white horizontal stripes, purple with slanted stripes, and peach with solid fill. The machine description mentions some hatch patterns but does not clearly capture the full stripe/color styling as described in the reference.
